title: Effect of Consumption of Black Cumin (Nigella Sativa L.) Water Extract on Weight Loss in Overweight Women
brief_summary: The purpose of this clinical trial is to study the therapeutic effect of black cumin water extract (Nigella sativa L.) on obesity and overweight
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Being Obese

Exclusion Criteria:

* Having heart disease or renal disease
* using drugs influencing metabolism and appetite
